title: Between Two Rounds
logline: At a small temple-run elders' home, the same two carers move within one hour from helping a resident through a hard, frightened moment to sitting with another whose grandchild has just visited with good news.

object.note: Object 6 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: Relief in a working body gives way to bodies that can no longer carry much: carers at an elders' home moving within one hour from a frightened moment to good news.

thread_out.thread: From the day's rounds at the elders' home to night rounds in a hospital, where a volunteer's tea trolley reaches families who have not left in days.

lesson.in_simple_terms: Care is not one fixed mood. The texts say compassion arises toward someone who is suffering and gladness toward someone who is happy, each in response to the person actually in front of you, so the same carer can move from one to the other within an hour.
lesson.in_simple_terms_si: දුකින් සිටින කෙනෙකු ඉදිරියේ ඒ දුක නැති වේවා යන පැතුමත්, සතුටින් සිටින කෙනෙකු ඉදිරියේ ඒ සතුටට සතුටු වීමත් වෙන වෙනම ඇති වන බැවින්, එකම සාත්තුකරුවෙකුට පැයක් ඇතුළත එකින් අනෙකට මාරු විය හැකිය.
lesson.the_teaching: In the good minds of everyday life, compassion and sympathetic joy are occasional factors: the Pradeepika says compassion is present when a person is moved by beings who are suffering, and sympathetic joy when they attend to beings who are happy. The Margaya describes compassion as not bearing others' suffering and wanting to free them from it. Among the four sublime abidings, compassion's failure is sorrow that grows under its cover, and equanimity is the even-mindedness that remains when there is nothing more one can do.
lesson.how_the_film_shows_it: The film follows the same two carers from morning routines into a resident's hard, frightened moment, then down the corridor to another room where a grandchild's visit has just brought good news. The viewer sees their voices, pace and faces change with each room, and the walk between the two rounds is where the shift can be noticed.

key_terms.en: compassion: wishing a suffering being free of suffering
sympathetic joy: gladness at others' good fortune
happy / suffering beings, the objects of sympathetic joy / compassion

lesson.caution: This does not mean compassion is measured by how much a carer shares someone's pain; the texts describe it as the steady wish and effort to relieve suffering.
lesson.builds_on: Relief in a working body gives way to bodies that can no longer carry much, and the four shapes of care seen in one family now have to be found by carers for strangers, within a single hour.
